Hud_UpdateCountdownFade - confidence 70.

Per-frame update for the two countdown Mode3D widgets (hud+0x24c "ReadyGo",
hud+0x250 "Cockpit321Go", both bound by Hud_BindWidgets). Reads a fade timer
at hud+0x16c, driven by param_1 (a dt-like input) while a gate byte at
*(hud->0x3c)+0x58/+0x59 is set. Over the span 0..1 it eases an alpha byte
through func_0x0010e2b4 (colour word (alpha<<24)|0x050517 for ReadyGo,
0xffffffff for Cockpit321Go) and toggles a "hidden" bit (widget_node+0x2c,
bit 0x4) on the widget's own +0x94 node pointer once the fade completes or
before the gate opens. A second check hides both again unless
*(_DAT_0005801c+0x2c0)+0x6f is set and the HUD's mode field (hud+0x284) isn't
6.

**This function never writes a widget's screen position** (no store to the
sight convention's +0x98/+0x9c, or to any offset on hud+0x24c/+0x250's own
widget struct beyond the +0x94 node's +0x2c flags). It is the direct
counterpart of HudSight_Update in the sense that both are "the per-frame
driver for a Bind'd widget set", and the absence of a position write here -
where HudSight_Update's presence is exactly what argues the sights need one -
is the main evidence that no runtime placement law exists for the countdown
widgets on this title. See countdown-widgets.md.

the same idiom HudSight_Bind uses) and stores each pointer on the HUD object.
Includes the two countdown widgets this page is about:
  "HUD->ReadyGo"       (immediate 0x276060 + 0x08804000 = 0x08a7a060) -> hud+0x24c
  "HUD->Cockpit321Go"  (immediate 0x276068 + 0x08804000 = 0x08a7a068) -> hud+0x250

actual bytes at 0x08a79c28 ("HUD->") and 0x08a79cd4 ("missile_sight_1"),
which is 0x275c28/0x275cd4 + 0x08804000 exactly.

Airbrake_Update - the flap's per-instance handler, reached indirectly (no
direct callers found, same shape as Exhaust_Update).

param_1 is the Airbrake node. +0x64 is a left/right flag byte (0 -> right,
else -> left); +0x68 -> entity; entity+0x94 -> craft (the reciprocal
ENTITY_OWNER edge documented in engine.md); craft+0x2d8/+0x2dc are the
graphics-only deflection states (0..100), craft+0x6c -> handling stats block,
whose own +0x6c/+0x70/+0x74 are AirbrakeGraphics amount/up_speed/down_speed
(camera.md, ship-parts.md).

angle = (deflection/100) * amount_radians
matrix = rotate about local X by angle:
  [1  0     0    0]
  [0  cos  sin  0]
  [0 -sin  cos  0]
  [0  0     0    1]
(row-major; vpfxs [0,X,Z,0]/[0,-Z,X,0] place cos into row1.y and row2.y,
sin into row1.z and -sin into row2.y - textbook rotation-about-X.)

deflection == 0 takes the FUN_00141588 branch instead (stowed / no override);
nonzero calls FUN_00141284(node, &matrix, 0) to install it. Both addresses are
unrelocated import-stub constants in this project's Ghidra import
(psp-pulse-usas-import-carries-unrelocated-address-constants), not resolvable
here.

watchpoint on craft+0x2d8 (this function is 1929 of 3210 reads captured while
the deflection was nonzero, by far the dominant reader) and by the vcst.s
2/PI constant, which is exactly the radians -> PSP quarter-turn scale the
already-recovered "amount is radians" reading (ship-parts.md, confidence 92)
predicts.
